# AGENTS.md — /fixtures (Lane C)

Owned by Lane C. See [../docs/lanes/LANE_C_INTEGRATIONS.md](../docs/lanes/LANE_C_INTEGRATIONS.md).

**Lanes A and B: do not edit these files.** If you need a new scenario, ask Lane C.
Editing fixtures to make your own code pass is the fastest way to break someone else's.

## What this is

The seeded four-week history that the whole demo runs on. A judge experiences the
fixtures, not the code — treat them as a first-class deliverable.

Generated by `python -m quiet_hours_integrations.mock.seed --out fixtures/`.
Committed so that `make demo` works on a clean clone with no generation step.

## The narrative these must produce

| Week | Decisions raised | Handled silently |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | ~9 | ~4 |
| 2 | ~6 | ~11 |
| 3 | ~3 | ~19 |
| 4 | ~2 | ~26 |

That curve is the demo's headline chart. Build backwards from it.

Scenario list: see the lane brief. Use real-looking UK merchants and amounts — never
"Acme Corp". Roughly 60% of the inbox should be noise the agent correctly ignores.
